text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Russian newspapers this morning. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The ten days since the auction of the government's stake in Svyazinvest, Russia's telecommunication giant, have shaken the country's establishment.
- Special measures are to be taken to ensure the safety of the Mir orbital station and its crew during future dockings with cargo ships.
- The current banking war in Russia has been to a certain extent initiated by the ruling authorities but it may lead to consequences which they have not foreseen.
- Russia's Eastern oil company is to be auctioned soon. The public is expecting a new scandal.
